title: 之 in formal writing
pattern: Modifier + 之 + Noun  ·  …之一 / …之际 / …之后  ·  Verb + 之 (= it / them)
summary: Use the classical particle 之 as a formal 的 or as a fixed object pronoun: 原因之一, 值此…之际, 取之于民.
explanation: **之 (zhī)** is the classical ancestor of **的**. In modern formal writing it survives mainly in fixed frames: **…之一** (one of …), **…之际** (on the occasion of …), **…之前 / 之后 / 之间 / 之中**, and in compact noun phrases such as **公司之未来**, **成功之道**. It sounds compressed and literary where 的 sounds neutral.

After a verb, 之 can also be an **object pronoun** meaning 'it / them', but only in set expressions and parallel formal phrasing: **取之于民，用之于民** (taken from the people, used for the people), **听之任之**, **总之**. You cannot freely replace 它 or 他们 with 之 in everyday sentences.

**Register:** speeches, official notices, news headlines, essays. In speech people say **…的**, **其中一个**, **…的时候**. Using 之 with personal, everyday words (✗ 我之朋友) sounds affected or wrong. A good rule: if the surrounding words are colloquial, use 的.
mistakes: ✗ 我之朋友明天来我家玩。 → ✓ 我的朋友明天来我家玩。 之 clashes with an everyday, colloquial sentence; use 的.
✗ 这是最重要的原因之一个。 → ✓ 这是最重要的原因之一。 之一 is a fixed unit; never add a measure word.

examples.hanzi: 中国是世界上历史最悠久的国家之一。
examples.pinyin: Zhōngguó shì shìjiè shang lìshǐ zuì yōujiǔ de guójiā zhī yī.
examples.english: China is one of the countries with the longest history in the world.

examples.hanzi: 值此新年来临之际，谨向各位致以诚挚的问候。
examples.pinyin: Zhí cǐ xīnnián láilín zhī jì, jǐn xiàng gèwèi zhìyǐ chéngzhì de wènhòu.
examples.english: As the New Year approaches, we extend our sincere greetings to you all.
examples.note: 值此…之际 is a standard opening in formal speeches and letters.

examples.hanzi: 此事关系到公司之未来，务必慎重处理。
examples.pinyin: Cǐ shì guānxì dào gōngsī zhī wèilái, wùbì shènzhòng chǔlǐ.
examples.english: This matter concerns the company's future and must be handled with great care.

examples.hanzi: 税收取之于民，用之于民。
examples.pinyin: Shuìshōu qǔ zhī yú mín, yòng zhī yú mín.
examples.english: Taxes are taken from the people and used for the people.
examples.note: 之 = 'it' (the taxes), object of 取 and 用.

exercises.sentence: 长城是世界上最著名的建筑___一。
exercises.english: The Great Wall is one of the most famous structures in the world.
exercises.explanation: …之一 = 'one of …'. 其 means 'its', 于 and 以 are prepositions.

exercises.sentence: 在两国建交五十周年___际，双方领导人互致贺电。
exercises.english: On the occasion of the fiftieth anniversary of diplomatic relations, the two leaders exchanged congratulatory messages.
exercises.explanation: The fixed frame is 在 / 值此 … 之际 'on the occasion of'.

options: 这是我国当前面临的最大挑战之一。
值此佳节之际，祝大家阖家幸福。
我之妈妈每天早上给我做早饭。
两国之间的贸易往来日益频繁。
exercises.explanation: 我之妈妈 mixes a literary particle with an intimate, everyday sentence. Say 我妈妈 / 我的妈妈.

exercises.english: Taxes are taken from the people and used for the people.
options: 税收取其于民，用其于民。
税收取之以民，用之以民。
税收取之于民，用之于民。
税收取于之民，用于之民。
exercises.explanation: 之 is the object ('it') right after the verb, and 于民 'from / for the people' follows it.

exercises.english: As the Spring Festival approaches, we extend our greetings to you all.
exercises.pinyin: Zhí cǐ Chūnjié láilín zhī jì, jǐn xiàng gèwèi zhìyǐ wènhòu.
exercises.explanation: 值此 + event + 之际 opens the sentence; 谨向…致以… is the formal greeting formula.

title: 其 as a formal pronoun
pattern: 其 + Noun (= his / her / its / their)  ·  使 / 令 / 促使 + 其 + Verb
summary: 其 replaces 他的 / 它的 / 他们的 in writing, and 他 / 它 after causative verbs: 以其服务著称, 令其停车.
explanation: **其 (qí)** is a third-person pronoun of written Chinese. Most often it is **possessive**: 其 = 他的 / 她的 / 它的 / 他们的. Because the possessive meaning is built in, you never add 的: **其作品**, not ✗ 其的作品. A very common combination is **A 及其 B** 'A and its / their B'.

Its second main use is as the object-and-subject of a pivot after causative verbs: **使其…**, **令其…**, **促使其…**, **要求其…**. Here 其 = 'him / her / it / them' and is followed by another verb: **交警令其停车** (the police ordered him to stop).

**Register:** formal reports, news, legal and academic writing. In speech you would say **他的 / 它的** and **让他…**. 其 is normally not used as a standalone object at the end of a clause (✗ 我很喜欢其) or as the subject of an ordinary spoken sentence.
mistakes: ✗ 这位作家及其的作品深受读者喜爱。 → ✓ 这位作家及其作品深受读者喜爱。 其 already means 'his'; adding 的 is redundant.
✗ 这本书写得很好，我很喜欢其。 → ✓ 这本书写得很好，我很喜欢它。 其 cannot be a bare sentence-final object.

examples.hanzi: 这家企业以其优质的服务赢得了顾客的信任。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā qǐyè yǐ qí yōuzhì de fúwù yíngdé le gùkè de xìnrèn.
examples.english: This company has won customers' trust through its high-quality service.

examples.hanzi: 我们应当尊重每个民族及其文化传统。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen yīngdāng zūnzhòng měi gè mínzú jí qí wénhuà chuántǒng.
examples.english: We should respect every ethnic group and its cultural traditions.

examples.hanzi: 对于违规车辆，交警有权令其停车接受检查。
examples.pinyin: Duìyú wéiguī chēliàng, jiāojǐng yǒu quán lìng qí tíngchē jiēshòu jiǎnchá.
examples.english: Traffic police have the right to order vehicles that break the rules to stop for inspection.
examples.note: 令其 = 让它 / 让他们.

examples.hanzi: 此方案虽有其优点，但成本过高。
examples.pinyin: Cǐ fāng'àn suī yǒu qí yōudiǎn, dàn chéngběn guò gāo.
examples.english: Although this plan has its advantages, the cost is too high.

exercises.sentence: 该公司以___先进的技术闻名业内。
exercises.english: The company is known in the industry for its advanced technology.
exercises.explanation: 其 = 'its' and takes no 的. 之 cannot be a possessive pronoun; 他们 is too colloquial here and would need 的.

exercises.sentence: 家长应当正确引导孩子，使___养成良好的阅读习惯。
exercises.english: Parents should guide children properly so that they develop good reading habits.
exercises.explanation: After causative 使, the formal pronoun is 其 (= 他们), followed by a verb.

options: 这位画家及其的学生举办了联合画展。
该地区以其独特的自然风光吸引了大批游客。
法院要求其在十日内履行判决。
exercises.explanation: 及其的 is wrong: 其 already contains the possessive. Say 及其学生.

exercises.english: We should respect every ethnic group and its traditions.
options: Wǒmen yīngdāng zūnzhòng měi gè mínzú jí qí chuántǒng.
Wǒmen yīngdāng zūnzhòng měi gè mínzú jí zhī chuántǒng.
Wǒmen yīngdāng zūnzhòng měi gè mínzú jí qí de chuántǒng.
Wǒmen yīngdāng zūnzhòng měi gè mínzú yǐ qí chuántǒng.
exercises.explanation: 及其 (jí qí) = 'and its'. 及之 is not a phrase, 其的 is redundant, and 以其 means 'by means of its'.

exercises.english: This museum is famous for its rich collection.
exercises.pinyin: Zhè jiā bówùguǎn yǐ qí fēngfù de cángpǐn ér wénmíng.
exercises.explanation: 以 + 其 + noun phrase + 而 + 闻名: 'famous for its …'.

title: 于 as an all-purpose formal preposition
pattern: 于 + Time / Place + Verb  ·  Verb + 于 + Place / Time  ·  Adj + 于 + B (= 比 B + Adj)  ·  有利于 / 取决于 / 致力于
summary: 于 covers 在, 从, 对, 给 and 比 in writing: 于明天举行, 建于明朝, 高于去年, 有利于健康.
explanation: **于 (yú)** is the workhorse preposition of formal Chinese. With time and place it means **在 / 从**: **会议将于明天举行**, **该桥建于明朝**, **毕业于北京大学**. It can come before the verb (time) or right after the verb (place, origin).
After an adjective, **于 marks comparison**: **A 高于 B** = A 比 B 高, **优于 / 低于 / 多于 / 少于 / 等于**. Never combine this with 比 (✗ 比…高于).

Many formal verbs are fused with 于 and must keep it: **有利于, 有助于, 取决于, 致力于, 属于, 在于, 敢于, 善于, 便于, 归功于**. **Register:** official, news and academic writing; in speech use **在 / 从 / 比 / 对…有好处** instead. 我今天于家吃饭 would sound absurdly stiff.
mistakes: ✗ 这种方法比传统方法优于。 → ✓ 这种方法优于传统方法。 Comparative 于 replaces 比; do not use both.
✗ 适当运动有利身体健康于。 → ✓ 适当运动有利于身体健康。 于 is attached to 有利 and precedes its object.

examples.hanzi: 该博物馆始建于明朝。
examples.pinyin: Gāi bówùguǎn shǐ jiàn yú Míngcháo.
examples.english: The museum was first built in the Ming dynasty.

examples.hanzi: 适当运动有利于身心健康。
examples.pinyin: Shìdàng yùndòng yǒulì yú shēnxīn jiànkāng.
examples.english: Moderate exercise is good for physical and mental health.

examples.hanzi: 今年的粮食产量略高于去年。
examples.pinyin: Jīnnián de liángshi chǎnliàng lüè gāo yú qùnián.
examples.english: This year's grain output is slightly higher than last year's.
examples.note: 高于去年 = 比去年高.

examples.hanzi: 成功与否，很大程度上取决于团队的合作。
examples.pinyin: Chénggōng yǔ fǒu, hěn dà chéngdù shang qǔjué yú tuánduì de hézuò.
examples.english: Whether we succeed depends to a large extent on teamwork.

exercises.sentence: 本次年会将___下周一上午九点正式开幕。
exercises.english: This year's annual meeting will officially open at 9 a.m. next Monday.
exercises.explanation: 于 + time before the verb = formal 在.

exercises.sentence: 实践证明，新材料的性能明显优___传统材料。
exercises.english: Practice has shown that the new material clearly outperforms traditional ones.
exercises.explanation: 优于 B = better than B. 比 would need to come before the noun (比传统材料好).

options: 今年的收入比去年高于百分之十。
他毕业北京大学于二〇二〇年。
公司的发展取决于每一位员工的努力。
多读书有助提高写作水平于。
exercises.explanation: 取决于 + object is correct. The others misplace 于 or combine it with 比.

exercises.english: Moderate exercise is good for physical and mental health.
options: 适当运动有利于身心健康。
适当运动有利以身心健康。
适当运动于身心健康有利于。
适当运动有利之身心健康。
exercises.explanation: 有利于 + object. 于 cannot be doubled or replaced with 以 / 之 here.

exercises.english: This sports meet will be held next May.
exercises.pinyin: Běn jiè yùndònghuì jiāng yú míngnián wǔyuè jǔxíng.
exercises.explanation: Subject + 将 + 于 + time + verb is the standard announcement pattern.

title: 以: by means of, take as, in order to
pattern: 以 + Means + Verb  ·  以 + A + 为 + B  ·  Clause, + 以 + Purpose Verb
summary: 以 means 'with / by' (以优异的成绩), 'take A as B' (以…为中心), or 'so as to' (以促进发展).
explanation: **以 (yǐ) + means** is the formal **用 / 凭**: **以优异的成绩考入大学**, **以实际行动支持**. It can express manner, tool, or basis.

**以 A 为 B (yǐ A wéi B)** means 'take A as B / regard A as B': **以人为本**, **以事实为依据**, **以客户为中心**. Note that 为 is read **wéi** here. Common variants are **以…为主** 'mainly …' and **以…为例** 'take … as an example'.

At the start of a second clause, **以 + verb** expresses purpose, like **来 / 为了**: **出台措施，以促进经济发展**. Related compounds: **以便** (so that), **以免** (so as to avoid). **Register:** all three uses are written and formal; in speech say **用…**, **把 A 当作 B**, **为了…**.
mistakes: ✗ 学校工作应以学生是中心。 → ✓ 学校工作应以学生为中心。 The frame is 以…为…, never 以…是….
✗ 以…为 read as 'yǐ … wèi …' → ✓ yǐ … wéi …. In this frame 为 means 'to be / act as' and takes the second tone.

examples.hanzi: 我们应当以事实为依据，以法律为准绳。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen yīngdāng yǐ shìshí wéi yījù, yǐ fǎlǜ wéi zhǔnshéng.
examples.english: We should take facts as the basis and the law as the yardstick.

examples.hanzi: 他以优异的成绩考入了北京大学。
examples.pinyin: Tā yǐ yōuyì de chéngjì kǎorù le Běijīng Dàxué.
examples.english: He was admitted to Peking University with outstanding results.

examples.hanzi: 政府出台了一系列措施，以促进经济发展。
examples.pinyin: Zhèngfǔ chūtái le yí xìliè cuòshī, yǐ cùjìn jīngjì fāzhǎn.
examples.english: The government introduced a series of measures to promote economic development.
examples.note: Purpose 以 = 为了 / 来.

examples.hanzi: 本公司始终以客户需求为导向。
examples.pinyin: Běn gōngsī shǐzhōng yǐ kèhù xūqiú wéi dǎoxiàng.
examples.english: Our company has always been guided by customer needs.

exercises.sentence: 学校的一切工作都应以学生___中心。
exercises.english: All of the school's work should centre on the students.
exercises.explanation: 以 A 为 B is the fixed frame; 是 and 于 do not fit, and 作 would need 作为.

exercises.sentence: 各地进一步加强了市场监管，___确保食品安全。
exercises.english: All regions have further strengthened market supervision so as to ensure food safety.
exercises.explanation: 以 + verb expresses purpose. 以免 means 'so as to avoid' and contradicts 确保.

options: 本文以上海为例，分析城市化的问题。
这里的居民以农业为主要收入来源。
他以实际行动证明了自己的能力。
我们公司以质量是生命。
exercises.explanation: 以…是… is not a pattern. Say 我们公司以质量为生命.

exercises.english: He was admitted to the university with outstanding results.
options: 他于优异的成绩考入了大学。
他以优异的成绩考入了大学。
他为优异的成绩考入了大学。
他之优异的成绩考入了大学。
exercises.explanation: 以 + means: 'with / by virtue of'. 于 marks time / place, 为 means 'for'.

exercises.english: We must adhere to putting people first.
exercises.pinyin: Wǒmen bìxū jiānchí yǐ rén wéi běn.
exercises.explanation: 以人为本 = take people as the root: 以 + A + 为 + B.

title: 则, 乃, 亦: formal 就, 是, 也
pattern: Condition + 则 + Result  ·  A…, B + 则 + … (contrast)  ·  A + 乃 + B  ·  Subject + 亦 + Verb
summary: Three one-syllable literary adverbs: 则 (then / whereas), 乃 (is, precisely), 亦 (also).
explanation: **则 (zé)** has two jobs. (1) Like **就** after a condition, often paired with **若 / 如**: **欲速则不达** (haste makes waste), **若不及时治疗，则后果严重**. (2) In contrast sentences it follows the second topic and means 'whereas, on the other hand': **南方多雨，北方则较为干燥**. In this contrastive use it must come after the new subject, not before it.

**乃 (nǎi)** is a literary copula 'is, is precisely', stronger and more solemn than 是: **诚信乃立身之本**. It has no negative form: to negate, use **并非 / 非** (✗ 乃不是). **亦 (yì)** = **也**, placed before the verb: **本公司亦将承担责任**.
**Register:** all three belong to formal written style, set phrases and speeches. In conversation say **就 / 而 / 是 / 也**. Dropping 亦 into a casual sentence (✗ 我亦想去看电影) sounds mock-classical.
mistakes: ✗ 南方多雨，则北方较为干燥。 → ✓ 南方多雨，北方则较为干燥。 Contrastive 则 follows the new topic.
✗ 他乃不是坏人。 → ✓ 他并非坏人。 乃 cannot be negated; use 并非 / 非.
✗ 我亦想去看电影，你呢？ → ✓ 我也想去看电影，你呢？ 亦 is out of place in casual speech.

examples.hanzi: 欲速则不达。
examples.pinyin: Yù sù zé bù dá.
examples.english: More haste, less speed.

examples.hanzi: 南方多雨，北方则较为干燥。
examples.pinyin: Nánfāng duō yǔ, běifāng zé jiàowéi gānzào.
examples.english: The south gets a lot of rain, whereas the north is relatively dry.

examples.hanzi: 诚信乃立身之本。
examples.pinyin: Chéngxìn nǎi lìshēn zhī běn.
examples.english: Integrity is the very foundation of one's life.

examples.hanzi: 如因质量问题造成损失，本公司亦将承担相应责任。
examples.pinyin: Rú yīn zhìliàng wèntí zàochéng sǔnshī, běn gōngsī yì jiāng chéngdān xiāngyìng zérèn.
examples.english: If losses are caused by quality problems, our company will also bear the corresponding responsibility.

exercises.sentence: 城市居民多选择公共交通，农村居民___更依赖摩托车。
exercises.english: Urban residents mostly choose public transport, whereas rural residents rely more on motorbikes.
exercises.explanation: Contrastive 则 after the second topic = 'whereas'.

exercises.sentence: 健康___人生最大的财富。
exercises.english: Health is life's greatest wealth.
exercises.explanation: 乃 is the literary copula 'is (precisely)'.

exercises.sentence: 甲方已签字确认，乙方___同意上述条款。
exercises.english: Party A has signed to confirm, and Party B also agrees to the above terms.
exercises.explanation: 亦 = 也. 则 would suggest a contrast, which the sentence does not have.

options: 前者重理论，后者则重实践。
该方案亦存在一定风险。
exercises.explanation: 乃 cannot be negated. Say 此并非我的本意.

exercises.english: The former emphasises theory, whereas the latter emphasises practice.
exercises.pinyin: Qiánzhě zhùzhòng lǐlùn, hòuzhě zé zhùzhòng shíjiàn.
exercises.explanation: Topic 2 + 则 + predicate: contrastive 则 follows the subject.

title: 予以 / 给以: formally grant or apply
pattern: (对 + Target) + 予以 + Disyllabic Verb  ·  给以 + Disyllabic Verb  ·  不予 + Verb
summary: Official verbs that 'apply' an action to someone: 予以表彰, 依法予以查处, 给以支持, 不予受理.
explanation: **予以 (yǔyǐ)** and **给以 (gěiyǐ)** are 'dummy' verbs that take a **disyllabic verb used as a noun**: **予以表彰** (commend), **予以批评**, **予以处罚**, **给以帮助**, **给以支持**. The person or thing affected is introduced earlier with **对 / 对于** or is the topic: **对表现突出的员工予以表彰**.

予以 is the stiffer of the two and dominates in regulations, court rulings and official notices. Its negative is **不予**: **不予受理** (will not be accepted), **不予批准**, **不予退还**. 给以 is a little softer and often appears with positive actions (help, care, support).

**Register:** bureaucratic and legal. In speech you would just use the verb itself: **表扬他, 帮助他们, 不收**. Do not put the recipient directly after 予以 (✗ 予以他表扬), and do not use a single-syllable verb (✗ 予以帮).
mistakes: ✗ 公司予以他表扬。 → ✓ 公司对他予以表扬。 The recipient is introduced with 对, not placed after 予以.
✗ 希望大家给以帮。 → ✓ 希望大家给以帮助。 予以 / 给以 need a disyllabic verb.

examples.hanzi: 对于表现突出的员工，公司将予以表彰。
examples.pinyin: Duìyú biǎoxiàn tūchū de yuángōng, gōngsī jiāng yǔyǐ biǎozhāng.
examples.english: The company will commend employees who perform outstandingly.

examples.hanzi: 对违法行为，有关部门必须依法予以查处。
examples.pinyin: Duì wéifǎ xíngwéi, yǒuguān bùmén bìxū yīfǎ yǔyǐ cháchǔ.
examples.english: Relevant authorities must investigate and deal with illegal acts according to law.

examples.hanzi: 希望社会各界给以关心和帮助。
examples.pinyin: Xīwàng shèhuì gèjiè gěiyǐ guānxīn hé bāngzhù.
examples.english: We hope all sectors of society will offer their care and help.

examples.hanzi: 不符合条件的申请，一律不予受理。
examples.pinyin: Bù fúhé tiáojiàn de shēnqǐng, yílǜ bù yǔ shòulǐ.
examples.english: Applications that do not meet the requirements will not be accepted.
examples.note: 不予 is the negative of 予以.

exercises.sentence: 对于见义勇为的行为，政府应当___表彰和奖励。
exercises.english: The government should commend and reward acts of bravery.
exercises.explanation: 予以 + disyllabic verb(s). The other options are not words or mean 'therefore'.

exercises.sentence: 逾期提交的材料，本单位一律不___受理。
exercises.english: Materials submitted after the deadline will not be accepted by this office.
exercises.explanation: 不予 + verb is the fixed negative form: 不予受理.

options: 对于群众反映的问题，我们将及时予以答复。
学校予以他严重警告处分。
对困难家庭，社区给以了必要的帮助。
exercises.explanation: The recipient cannot follow 予以 directly. Say 学校对他予以严重警告处分 / 学校给予他严重警告处分.

exercises.english: Applications that do not meet the requirements will not be accepted.
options: 不符合条件的申请，一律予以不受理。
不符合条件的申请，一律不予受理。
不符合条件的申请，一律不给以受。
不符合条件的申请，一律予以没受理。
exercises.explanation: The negative is 不予 + verb, not 予以不….

exercises.english: Violations will be punished according to law.
exercises.pinyin: Duì wéiguī xíngwéi jiāng yīfǎ yǔyǐ chǔfá.
exercises.explanation: 对 + target + 将 + manner (依法) + 予以 + verb.

title: 为…所…: the literary passive
pattern: Subject + 为 + Agent + 所 + Verb  ·  Subject + 被 + Agent + 所 + Verb
summary: A formal passive: 为学术界所公认, 为广大读者所熟知, 被困难所吓倒.
explanation: **为 (wéi) + agent + 所 (suǒ) + verb** is the classical passive, still very productive in formal writing: **该理论为学术界所公认** (the theory is recognised by academia). 为 here is read **wéi**, not wèi. The agent is normally required, and the verb is usually disyllabic.
A hybrid form **被…所…** is also accepted in writing: **不要被表面现象所迷惑**. Both often describe **mental or perceptual states**: 所感动, 所接受, 所熟知, 所吸引, 所困扰, 所取代.

**Register:** essays, academic and news writing. In speech use **被** (被大家接受) or an active sentence (大家都知道). Avoid adding 了 or a complement after the verb; put aspect information before 为 instead (**已为…所接受**).
mistakes: ✗ 这个观点为专家们所接受了。 → ✓ 这个观点已为专家们所接受。 Express completion with 已 before 为, not 了 after the verb.
✗ 为…所 read 'wèi … suǒ' → ✓ 'wéi … suǒ'. In the passive frame 为 is second tone.

examples.hanzi: 人们深深为他的事迹所感动。
examples.pinyin: Rénmen shēnshēn wéi tā de shìjì suǒ gǎndòng.
examples.english: People were deeply moved by his deeds.

examples.hanzi: 该发现很快为学术界所公认。
examples.pinyin: Gāi fāxiàn hěn kuài wéi xuéshùjiè suǒ gōngrèn.
examples.english: The discovery was soon universally recognised by the academic world.

examples.hanzi: 这位作家的作品早已为广大读者所熟知。
examples.pinyin: Zhè wèi zuòjiā de zuòpǐn zǎo yǐ wéi guǎngdà dúzhě suǒ shúzhī.
examples.english: This writer's works have long been familiar to a wide readership.
examples.note: Measure word 位 is wèi; passive 为 is wéi.

examples.hanzi: 我们不能被眼前的困难所吓倒。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen bù néng bèi yǎnqián de kùnnan suǒ xiàdǎo.
examples.english: We must not be intimidated by the difficulties in front of us.

exercises.sentence: 这一理论逐渐___学术界所接受。
exercises.english: This theory gradually came to be accepted by the academic world.
exercises.explanation: 为 + agent + 所 + verb is the literary passive.

exercises.sentence: 观众深深为他的故事___感动。
exercises.english: The audience was deeply moved by his story.
exercises.explanation: The agent is followed by 所 before the verb.

options: 这种传统工艺已为现代技术所取代。
这种传统工艺已为所现代技术取代。
这种传统工艺已为现代技术所取代了。
这种传统工艺已所现代技术为取代。
exercises.explanation: Order: 为 + agent + 所 + verb, with completion marked by 已 and no 了 at the end.

exercises.english: His works are well known to readers.
options: Tā de zuòpǐn wèi dúzhě suǒ shúzhī.
Tā de zuòpǐn wéi dúzhě suǒ shúzhī.
Tā de zuòpǐn wéi dúzhě suó shúzhī.
Tā de zuòpǐn wèi dúzhě suō shúzhī.
exercises.explanation: Passive 为 is wéi, and 所 is suǒ.

exercises.english: Don't be misled by superficial appearances.
exercises.pinyin: Búyào bèi biǎomiàn xiànxiàng suǒ míhuo.
exercises.explanation: 被 + agent + 所 + verb, the hybrid written passive.

title: 有所 / 无所: to some extent, nothing to
pattern: Subject + 有所 + Disyllabic Verb  ·  无所 + Verb (set phrases)  ·  无所不 + Verb
summary: 有所提高 = improved somewhat; 无所事事 = with nothing to do; 无所不知 = knows everything.
explanation: **有所 (yǒusuǒ) + disyllabic verb** means 'to some degree, somewhat': **收入有所提高**, **病情有所好转**, **有所不同**, **有所了解**. It deliberately signals a **moderate** change, so it does not combine with strong degree words like 很大 or 大幅.

**无所 (wú suǒ) + verb** means 'there is nothing that one …' and lives mainly in set phrases: **无所事事** (idle), **无所适从** (not know what to follow), **无所畏惧** (fear nothing), **无所作为**. **无所不 + verb** means 'there is nothing one does not …' = everything: **无所不知, 无所不能, 无所不包**.

**Register:** reports, news and essays use 有所 constantly to hedge; in speech say **提高了一点 / 好了一些**. The 无所 phrases are idiomatic and appear in both writing and educated speech, but colloquially you might say **没事干**, **不知道该听谁的**.
mistakes: ✗ 今年的收入有所高。 → ✓ 今年的收入有所提高。 有所 needs a disyllabic verb.
✗ 他的成绩有所提高了很多。 → ✓ 他的成绩有所提高 / 他的成绩提高了很多。 有所 already implies a moderate change; do not add 很多.

examples.hanzi: 近年来，当地居民的收入有所提高。
examples.pinyin: Jìnnián lái, dāngdì jūmín de shōurù yǒusuǒ tígāo.
examples.english: In recent years, local residents' incomes have risen somewhat.

examples.hanzi: 经过治疗，他的病情有所好转。
examples.pinyin: Jīngguò zhìliáo, tā de bìngqíng yǒusuǒ hǎozhuǎn.
examples.english: After treatment, his condition has improved somewhat.

examples.hanzi: 他退休以后整天无所事事。
examples.pinyin: Tā tuìxiū yǐhòu zhěngtiān wú suǒ shì shì.
examples.english: Since retiring he has spent his days idle.

examples.hanzi: 规定朝令夕改，让大家无所适从。
examples.pinyin: Guīdìng zhāo lìng xī gǎi, ràng dàjiā wú suǒ shì cóng.
examples.english: The rules change constantly, leaving everyone at a loss as to what to follow.

exercises.sentence: 与去年相比，今年的失业率___下降。
exercises.english: Compared with last year, the unemployment rate has dropped somewhat this year.
exercises.explanation: 有所 + disyllabic verb = 'to some extent'.

exercises.sentence: 规定一天一变，让员工们无所___。
exercises.english: The rules change every day, leaving staff not knowing what to follow.
exercises.explanation: 无所适从 = at a loss what to follow. 无所事事 (idle), 无所畏惧 (fearless) and 无所作为 (achieve nothing) do not fit the cause.

options: 两种方法的效果有所不同。
我对这个领域有所了解。
exercises.explanation: 有所 expresses a moderate degree and cannot take 了很多. Say 物价有所上涨 or 物价上涨了很多.

exercises.english: After treatment, his condition improved somewhat.
options: 经过治疗，他的病情无所好转。
经过治疗，他的病情有所好。
经过治疗，他的病情有所好转。
经过治疗，他的病情所有好转。
exercises.explanation: 有所 + 好转 (disyllabic). 无所 would mean 'not at all', 所有 means 'all'.

exercises.english: The city's air quality has improved somewhat compared with last year.
exercises.pinyin: Chéngshì kōngqì zhìliàng bǐ qùnián yǒusuǒ gǎishàn.
exercises.explanation: 比 + comparison + 有所 + verb.

title: 不无: not without
pattern: Subject + 不无 + Noun / Disyllabic Verb  ·  A + 与 + B + 不无关系
summary: A cautious double negative: 不无道理 (has some merit), 不无关系 (is not unrelated), 不无遗憾.
explanation: **不无 (bù wú)** literally means 'not without' = **不是没有 / 有一些**. It lets a writer admit something **guardedly**: **他的说法不无道理** (what he says is not without merit). Typical objects: 道理, 关系, 遗憾, 担忧, 可能, 好处, 疑问.
Compare: **毫无 / 并无** = 'none at all'; **不无** = 'some'. So 不无 often pairs with a concession: **虽然片面，但也不无道理**. The phrase **A 与 B 不无关系** is a polite way to hint at a cause.
**Register:** written and formal speech (commentary, reviews, academic writing). In conversation say **有点道理**, **跟…有关系**. Because it is already a double negative, never add another negative (✗ 不无没有).
mistakes: ✗ 他的话不无没有道理。 → ✓ 他的话不无道理。 不无 already contains the double negative.
✗ 这个结论毫无道理，但也不无漏洞。 → ✓ 这个结论有一定道理，但也不无漏洞。 Keep the logic consistent: 不无 means 'has some'.

examples.hanzi: 他的说法虽然片面，但也不无道理。
examples.pinyin: Tā de shuōfǎ suīrán piànmiàn, dàn yě bù wú dàolǐ.
examples.english: Though one-sided, what he says is not without merit.

examples.hanzi: 这次失败与准备不足不无关系。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì shībài yǔ zhǔnbèi bùzú bù wú guānxì.
examples.english: This failure is not unrelated to insufficient preparation.

examples.hanzi: 谈起往事，老人的语气中不无遗憾。
examples.pinyin: Tán qǐ wǎngshì, lǎorén de yǔqì zhōng bù wú yíhàn.
examples.english: When talking about the past, there was some regret in the old man's voice.

examples.hanzi: 业内专家对该项目的前景不无担忧。
examples.pinyin: Yènèi zhuānjiā duì gāi xiàngmù de qiánjǐng bù wú dānyōu.
examples.english: Industry experts have some concerns about the project's prospects.

exercises.sentence: 他的批评虽然尖锐，却___道理。
exercises.english: His criticism, though sharp, is not without merit.
exercises.explanation: 却 signals a concession, so we need 'has some' = 不无. 毫无 / 并无 mean 'none at all'.

exercises.sentence: 公司业绩下滑与管理混乱不无___。
exercises.english: The company's declining performance is not unrelated to its chaotic management.
exercises.explanation: 不无 takes a noun: 不无关系. 相关 / 有关 are already predicates.

options: 这个建议不无可取之处。
exercises.explanation: 不无 is already a double negative; adding 没有 makes nonsense. Say 他的话不无道理.

exercises.english: What he says is not without merit.
options: 他说的话不无没有道理。
exercises.explanation: 不无道理 = 'not without reason'. 毫无 reverses the meaning; 不无没有 is a triple negative.

exercises.english: This accident is not unrelated to negligent management.
exercises.pinyin: Zhè cì shìgù yǔ guǎnlǐ shūhu bù wú guānxì.
exercises.explanation: A + 与 + B + 不无关系.

title: 何其: how very…!
pattern: Subject + 何其 + Adjective (+ ！)
summary: A literary exclamation = 多么: 人生何其短暂！两人的经历何其相似！
explanation: **何其 (héqí)** means 'how (very) …!' and is the literary counterpart of **多么 / 多 / 真**. It goes directly before an adjective (usually disyllabic) and the sentence is exclamatory: **人生何其短暂！**
It often carries a reflective, lamenting or ironic tone: **这种想法何其天真！** (how naive!) can be a criticism. It is not a question word: it never asks 'how much' or 'how'.
**Register:** essays, literary prose and speeches. In conversation say **多么… / 太…了 / 真…**. Do not add a degree adverb such as 很 or 非常 after it.
mistakes: ✗ 人生何其很短暂！ → ✓ 人生何其短暂！ 何其 already expresses degree; no 很.
✗ 这本书何其钱？ → ✓ 这本书多少钱？ 何其 is an exclamation, not a question word.

examples.hanzi: 人生何其短暂！
examples.pinyin: Rénshēng héqí duǎnzàn!
examples.english: How short life is!

examples.hanzi: 在那个年代，读书的机会何其难得。
examples.pinyin: Zài nàge niándài, dúshū de jīhuì héqí nándé.
examples.english: In those days, how rare the chance to study was.

examples.hanzi: 两个人的经历何其相似！
examples.pinyin: Liǎng gè rén de jīnglì héqí xiāngsì!
examples.english: How similar the two people's experiences are!

examples.hanzi: 以为靠运气就能成功，这种想法何其天真！
examples.pinyin: Yǐwéi kào yùnqi jiù néng chénggōng, zhè zhǒng xiǎngfǎ héqí tiānzhēn!
examples.english: Thinking that luck alone brings success — how naive!

exercises.sentence: 回首往事，时光___匆匆！
exercises.english: Looking back, how swiftly time has passed!
exercises.explanation: 何其 + adjective = 'how …!'. 何以 = why/how, 何必 = why bother, 何况 = let alone.

options: 这里的风景何其非常美丽！
exercises.explanation: 何其 cannot be followed by another degree adverb like 非常.

exercises.english: How short life is!
exercises.explanation: 何其 (héqí) + adjective, with no 很.

exercises.prompt: Fill in the blank with the everyday equivalent of 何其.
exercises.sentence: 这种想法___天真啊！
exercises.english: How naive this idea is!
exercises.explanation: 多么 is the everyday equivalent of 何其.

exercises.english: How similar the experiences of the two generations are!
exercises.pinyin: Liǎng dài rén de jīnglì héqí xiāngsì!
exercises.explanation: Subject + 何其 + adjective.

title: 倘若 / 若: formal 'if'
pattern: 倘若 / 若 + Condition, (Subject) + 就 / 便 / 将 + Result  ·  若 + Condition, 则 + Result  ·  若非 + X, …
summary: Written equivalents of 如果: 倘若明天下雨…, 若有疑问，请…, 若不及时处理，则….
explanation: **倘若 (tǎngruò)** and **若 (ruò)** mean 'if' and replace **如果 / 要是** in formal writing. 若 is the most compact and appears constantly in notices and regulations: **若有疑问，请与我们联系**. 倘若 is slightly more literary and often introduces hypothetical or counterfactual situations.
The result clause is linked with **就, 便, 将** or, especially after 若, with **则**: **若不及时治疗，则后果不堪设想**. **若非 (ruò fēi)** means 'if it were not for' = 要不是: **若非亲眼所见，我绝不会相信**.

**Register:** formal and written. In conversation use **如果 / 要是…的话**. Since 若 is a single syllable, it should be followed directly by a clause and not by a long pause; it is not used as a stand-alone answer like 'if so' (use **如果是这样**).
mistakes: ✗ 倘若明天下雨，所以比赛推迟。 → ✓ 倘若明天下雨，比赛将推迟。 A conditional is answered with 就 / 便 / 将 / 则, not 所以.
✗ 若是你有空，咱们去喝一杯吧！ → ✓ 要是你有空，咱们去喝一杯吧！ 若 is too stiff for a casual invitation.

examples.hanzi: 倘若明天下雨，比赛将推迟举行。
examples.pinyin: Tǎngruò míngtiān xià yǔ, bǐsài jiāng tuīchí jǔxíng.
examples.english: If it rains tomorrow, the match will be postponed.

examples.hanzi: 若有疑问，请及时与我们联系。
examples.pinyin: Ruò yǒu yíwèn, qǐng jíshí yǔ wǒmen liánxì.
examples.english: If you have any questions, please contact us promptly.

examples.hanzi: 倘若当初听从了专家的建议，也不至于造成如此大的损失。
examples.pinyin: Tǎngruò dāngchū tīngcóng le zhuānjiā de jiànyì, yě bú zhìyú zàochéng rúcǐ dà de sǔnshī.
examples.english: Had we followed the experts' advice back then, we would not have suffered such great losses.

examples.hanzi: 若非亲眼所见，我绝不会相信。
examples.pinyin: Ruò fēi qīnyǎn suǒ jiàn, wǒ jué bú huì xiāngxìn.
examples.english: Had I not seen it with my own eyes, I would never have believed it.

exercises.sentence: ___您对本次服务有任何意见，欢迎随时提出。
exercises.english: If you have any comments on our service, you are welcome to raise them at any time.
exercises.explanation: 倘若 = formal 'if'. 即便 = even if, which does not fit the invitation.

exercises.sentence: 若不及时治疗，___后果不堪设想。
exercises.english: If it is not treated promptly, the consequences will be unthinkable.
exercises.explanation: 若…，则… is the classic formal conditional pair.

options: 若发现问题，应立即上报。
倘若条件允许，我们将扩大生产。
倘若资金不足，所以项目暂停。
若非朋友帮忙，我早就放弃了。
exercises.explanation: 倘若 introduces a condition; the result needs 就 / 便 / 将 / 则, not 所以. Say 倘若资金不足，项目将暂停.

exercises.english: Had I not seen it with my own eyes, I would never have believed it.
options: 若非亲眼所见，我绝不会相信。
即便亲眼所见，我绝不会相信。
若是亲眼所见，我绝不会相信。
尚且亲眼所见，我绝不会相信。
exercises.explanation: 若非 = 'if not for / had … not'. The other options change the meaning.

exercises.english: If you have any questions, please contact us promptly.
exercises.pinyin: Ruò yǒu yíwèn, qǐng jíshí yǔ wǒmen liánxì.
exercises.explanation: 若 + condition, then the request 请…与…联系.

title: 纵然 / 纵使 / 即便: even if
titleHanzi: 纵然 · 纵使 · 即便
pattern: 纵然 / 纵使 / 即便 + Concession, Subject + 也 / 亦 / 仍 + Result
summary: Formal versions of 即使 'even if': 纵然困难重重，我们也绝不放弃.
explanation: **纵然 (zòngrán)**, **纵使 (zòngshǐ)** and **即便 (jíbiàn)** all mean 'even if / even though' like **即使 / 就算**. The second clause normally contains **也**, or in more literary style **亦 / 仍 / 还是**. The concession can be hypothetical or a real fact.

Nuances: **即便** is the most neutral of the three and is common in news and essays; **纵然 / 纵使** are more literary and emotional, often with strong images: **纵使有千般不舍**. **即便是 + noun** means 'even (for) …': **即便是专家，也…**.
**Register:** written and formal; in conversation say **就算…也…** or **即使…也…**. Do not confuse them with **既然** ('since'), which sounds similar to 即便 but states an accepted fact and is followed by 就.
mistakes: ✗ 即便下大雨，比赛就照常进行。 → ✓ 即便下大雨，比赛也照常进行。 Concession clauses pair with 也 / 仍, not 就.
✗ 即便你已经决定了，就去做吧。 → ✓ 既然你已经决定了，就去做吧。 'Since' is 既然; 即便 means 'even if'.

examples.hanzi: 纵然困难重重，我们也绝不放弃。
examples.pinyin: Zòngrán kùnnan chóngchóng, wǒmen yě jué bú fàngqì.
examples.english: Even if difficulties abound, we will never give up.

examples.hanzi: 纵使有千般不舍，他还是踏上了远行的路。
examples.pinyin: Zòngshǐ yǒu qiān bān bù shě, tā háishi tà shàng le yuǎnxíng de lù.
examples.english: Reluctant as he was to leave, he still set off on the long journey.

examples.hanzi: 即便是专家，也难以在短时间内找到答案。
examples.pinyin: Jíbiàn shì zhuānjiā, yě nányǐ zài duǎn shíjiān nèi zhǎodào dá'àn.
examples.english: Even an expert would find it hard to find the answer in a short time.

examples.hanzi: 即便失败了，这次尝试也很有意义。
examples.pinyin: Jíbiàn shībài le, zhè cì chángshì yě hěn yǒu yìyì.
examples.english: Even if it fails, this attempt is still very meaningful.

exercises.sentence: 纵使前路坎坷，他___从未想过放弃。
exercises.english: Even though the road ahead was rough, he never thought of giving up.
exercises.explanation: 纵使 / 纵然 / 即便 pair with 也 in the main clause.

exercises.sentence: ___是最有经验的医生，也不能保证手术百分之百成功。
exercises.english: Even the most experienced doctor cannot guarantee that an operation will be 100% successful.
exercises.explanation: 即便是 + noun = 'even (for) …', followed by 也.

options: 纵然条件艰苦，他们就坚持完成了任务。
即便你已经知道了，那就别再问了。
纵然条件艰苦，他们仍坚持完成了任务。
即便条件艰苦，所以他们坚持完成了任务。
exercises.explanation: 纵然 + concession, main clause with 仍 / 也. 就 and 所以 do not fit a concession.

exercises.english: Even if difficulties abound, we will never give up.
options: Jìrán kùnnan chóngchóng, wǒmen jiù jué bú fàngqì.
Zòngrán kùnnan chóngchóng, wǒmen yě jué bú fàngqì.
Zòngrán kùnnan zhòngzhòng, wǒmen yě jué bù fàngqì.
Tǎngruò kùnnan chóngchóng, wǒmen jiù jué bú fàngqì.
exercises.explanation: 纵然…也…; 重重 is chóngchóng here, and 不 before fàng is bú.

exercises.english: Even if it fails, this attempt is still very meaningful.
exercises.pinyin: Jíbiàn shībài le, zhè cì chángshì yě hěn yǒu yìyì.
exercises.explanation: 即便 + concession, main subject + 也 + predicate.

title: 殊不知: little do they know
pattern: Someone thinks / does X, + 殊不知 + Actual Fact
summary: Correct a mistaken belief: 很多人以为…，殊不知…. ('…, but in fact, unbeknown to them, …').
explanation: **殊不知 (shūbùzhī)** introduces a fact that **contradicts what someone believes or assumes**. The first clause states the belief or behaviour (often with **以为 / 自以为 / 只看到**), and 殊不知 reveals the truth: **很多人以为…，殊不知…**.

It is used about **other people** (or people in general), with an evaluative, often admonishing tone typical of commentary and popular-science writing. It is not used for the speaker's own simple ignorance (✗ 我殊不知他来了).
**Register:** written, argumentative. Colloquial equivalents are **其实… / 哪知道… / 却不知道…**. Note that 不 keeps its fourth tone here (bù) because 知 is first tone.
mistakes: ✗ 我殊不知他昨天来过。 → ✓ 我不知道他昨天来过。 殊不知 corrects others' mistaken beliefs; it is not a plain 'I didn't know'.
✗ 殊不知今天会下雨，我们出去玩吧。 → ✓ 他们以为今天不会下雨，殊不知下午就下起了大雨。 殊不知 needs a preceding belief to contradict.

examples.hanzi: 很多人以为多吃保健品有益健康，殊不知过量服用反而有害。
examples.pinyin: Hěn duō rén yǐwéi duō chī bǎojiànpǐn yǒuyì jiànkāng, shūbùzhī guòliàng fúyòng fǎn'ér yǒuhài.
examples.english: Many people think taking lots of supplements is healthy, not realising that overdoing it is actually harmful.

examples.hanzi: 他自以为聪明，殊不知早已落入别人的圈套。
examples.pinyin: Tā zì yǐwéi cōngming, shūbùzhī zǎo yǐ luòrù biérén de quāntào.
examples.english: He thought himself clever, little knowing he had long since fallen into someone else's trap.

examples.hanzi: 有些家长包办孩子的一切，殊不知这样会削弱孩子的独立能力。
examples.pinyin: Yǒuxiē jiāzhǎng bāobàn háizi de yíqiè, shūbùzhī zhèyàng huì xuēruò háizi de dúlì nénglì.
examples.english: Some parents do everything for their children, unaware that this weakens the children's independence.

examples.hanzi: 人们只看到他今天的成功，殊不知他背后付出了多少努力。
examples.pinyin: Rénmen zhǐ kàndào tā jīntiān de chénggōng, shūbùzhī tā bèihòu fùchū le duōshao nǔlì.
examples.english: People only see his success today, without knowing how much effort he put in behind the scenes.

exercises.sentence: 不少人认为熬夜工作效率更高，___长期熬夜会严重损害健康。
exercises.english: Many think working late is more efficient, not realising that staying up late long-term seriously harms health.
exercises.explanation: 殊不知 introduces the fact that contradicts the belief 认为….

options: 他以为瞒得很好，殊不知大家早就知道了。
有人觉得省钱就是少花钱，殊不知理财更重要。
人们只看到表面的风光，殊不知其中的艰辛。
exercises.explanation: 殊不知 is not a plain 'I don't know'. Say 我不知道明天要开会.

exercises.english: He thought himself clever, little knowing he had already fallen into a trap.
options: 他自以为聪明，难怪早已落入圈套。
他自以为聪明，殊不知早已落入圈套。
他殊不知聪明，自以为早已落入圈套。
他自以为聪明，何况早已落入圈套。
exercises.explanation: 殊不知 = 'little did he know', revealing a fact that contradicts his belief. 难怪 (no wonder) and 何况 (let alone) break the logic.

exercises.prompt: Choose the best colloquial paraphrase of 殊不知 in: 很多人以为…，殊不知….
exercises.sentence: 很多人以为喝咖啡能解渴，___咖啡会让人更渴。
exercises.english: Many people think coffee quenches thirst, but actually it makes you thirstier.
exercises.explanation: In speech, 其实 / 哪知道 do the job of 殊不知.

exercises.english: He thought himself clever, little knowing he had long since fallen into someone else's trap.
exercises.pinyin: Tā zì yǐwéi cōngming, shūbùzhī zǎo yǐ luòrù biérén de quāntào.
exercises.explanation: Belief clause first, then 殊不知 + the real situation.

title: 诚然…然而: admittedly…, however
pattern: 诚然 + Concession, 然而 / 但(是) / 可是 + Main Point  ·  诚然，Clause。然而，Clause。
summary: An essay frame that grants a point before arguing against it: 诚然，科技带来了便利，然而….
explanation: **诚然 (chéngrán)** means 'admittedly, it is true that'. It concedes a point the writer accepts, and the next clause — introduced by **然而 (rán'ér)**, **但(是)** or **可是** — makes the real argument. It may stand at the very start with a comma (**诚然，…**) or after the subject (**这个方案诚然有优点，但…**).

It is close to **固然** (HSK 6), but 诚然 sounds more like an argumentative essay and can head a whole sentence or paragraph; 固然 almost always sits after the subject. **然而** is the formal 'however' and is likewise preferred in writing over 可是.
**Register:** argumentative essays, editorials, academic discussion (a staple of HSK writing tasks). Colloquially: **确实…，不过…** or **是…，但是…**. Without the following turn, 诚然 sounds unfinished.
mistakes: ✗ 诚然，网络购物很方便，所以大家都喜欢。 → ✓ 诚然，网络购物很方便，然而也存在不少隐患。 诚然 sets up a contrast; it must be followed by 然而 / 但.
✗ 诚然他是专家，然而。 → ✓ 他诚然是专家，然而也会犯错。 然而 must introduce a full clause.

examples.hanzi: 诚然，科技给生活带来了便利，然而它也带来了新的问题。
examples.pinyin: Chéngrán, kējì gěi shēnghuó dàilái le biànlì, rán'ér tā yě dàilái le xīn de wèntí.
examples.english: Admittedly, technology has made life more convenient; however, it has also created new problems.

examples.hanzi: 这个方案诚然有不少优点，但实施起来难度很大。
examples.pinyin: Zhège fāng'àn chéngrán yǒu bù shǎo yōudiǎn, dàn shíshī qǐlai nándù hěn dà.
examples.english: This plan admittedly has many strengths, but it is very hard to implement.

examples.hanzi: 经济增长诚然重要，然而环境保护同样不可忽视。
examples.pinyin: Jīngjì zēngzhǎng chéngrán zhòngyào, rán'ér huánjìng bǎohù tóngyàng bù kě hūshì.
examples.english: Economic growth is certainly important, yet environmental protection must not be neglected either.

examples.hanzi: 他诚然是一位出色的学者，可在管理方面却缺乏经验。
examples.pinyin: Tā chéngrán shì yí wèi chūsè de xuézhě, kě zài guǎnlǐ fāngmiàn què quēfá jīngyàn.
examples.english: He is admittedly an outstanding scholar, but he lacks experience in management.

exercises.sentence: 诚然，考试成绩很重要，___综合素质的培养同样不可忽视。
exercises.english: Admittedly, exam results matter; however, developing all-round abilities must not be neglected.
exercises.explanation: 诚然 concedes; 然而 introduces the counterpoint.

exercises.sentence: ___，这种做法短期内能降低成本，但从长远来看弊大于利。
exercises.english: Admittedly, this approach can lower costs in the short term, but in the long run it does more harm than good.
exercises.explanation: A sentence-initial concession followed by 但 calls for 诚然.

options: 诚然，城市生活便利，然而压力也大。
他的观点诚然有道理，但并不全面。
诚然，网上购物很方便，所以大家都喜欢。
诚然，失败令人沮丧，然而它也是成长的机会。
exercises.explanation: 诚然 must be followed by a contrast (然而 / 但), not a result with 所以.

exercises.english: Economic growth is certainly important, yet environmental protection must not be neglected.
options: 经济增长诚然重要，然而环境保护同样不可忽视。
经济增长诚然重要，因此环境保护同样不可忽视。
经济增长然而重要，诚然环境保护同样不可忽视。
经济增长诚然重要，换言之环境保护同样不可忽视。
exercises.explanation: 诚然 (concession) … 然而 (contrast).

exercises.english: This plan admittedly has advantages, but the cost is too high.
exercises.pinyin: Zhège fāng'àn chéngrán yǒu yōudiǎn, dàn chéngběn guò gāo.
exercises.explanation: Subject + 诚然 + concession, 但 + main point.

title: 换言之, 与此同时, 不仅如此: linking sentences
titleHanzi: 换言之 · 与此同时 · 不仅如此
pattern: Statement，换言之，Restatement  ·  Development，与此同时，Parallel Development  ·  Statement。不仅如此，Further Point
summary: Three paragraph-level connectors: 换言之 (in other words), 与此同时 (at the same time), 不仅如此 (what's more).
explanation: **换言之 (huàn yán zhī)** = 'in other words' (= 换句话说). It **restates or draws out the meaning** of what was just said; it adds no new fact. **与此同时 (yǔ cǐ tóngshí)** = 'meanwhile, at the same time': it introduces a **parallel development**, often a contrasting or accompanying trend.

**不仅如此 (bùjǐn rúcǐ)** = 'not only that; moreover'. It closes the previous point and **adds a further, usually stronger point** in the same direction. It stands at the head of a new sentence or clause, usually followed by a comma, and the next clause often contains **还 / 也 / 更**.

**Register:** all three are typical of written argumentation, reports and formal speeches. In speech use **也就是说 / 同时 / 而且 / 还有**. Each is a sentence-level connector: it normally starts a clause and is set off by a comma.
mistakes: ✗ 这款手机很便宜。不仅如此，它的电池很差。 → ✓ 这款手机很便宜。不仅如此，它的电池也很耐用。 不仅如此 adds a point in the same (positive) direction, not a contrast.
✗ 他没有通过考试，换言之，他明年还想再考。 → ✓ 他没有通过考试，换言之，他还拿不到证书。 换言之 restates or draws out the same meaning; it does not add unrelated new information.

examples.hanzi: 该药物尚未通过临床试验，换言之，其安全性还无法保证。
examples.pinyin: Gāi yàowù shàng wèi tōngguò línchuáng shìyàn, huàn yán zhī, qí ānquánxìng hái wúfǎ bǎozhèng.
examples.english: The drug has not yet passed clinical trials; in other words, its safety cannot yet be guaranteed.

examples.hanzi: 城市规模不断扩大，与此同时，交通拥堵问题也日益严重。
examples.pinyin: Chéngshì guīmó búduàn kuòdà, yǔ cǐ tóngshí, jiāotōng yōngdǔ wèntí yě rìyì yánzhòng.
examples.english: Cities keep expanding; at the same time, traffic congestion is becoming increasingly serious.

examples.hanzi: 这款手机价格实惠。不仅如此，它的续航能力也相当出色。
examples.pinyin: Zhè kuǎn shǒujī jiàgé shíhuì. Bùjǐn rúcǐ, tā de xùháng nénglì yě xiāngdāng chūsè.
examples.english: This phone is reasonably priced. What's more, its battery life is excellent too.

examples.hanzi: 大多数受访者表示不愿加班，换言之，他们更看重工作与生活的平衡。
examples.pinyin: Dàduōshù shòufǎngzhě biǎoshì bú yuàn jiābān, huàn yán zhī, tāmen gèng kànzhòng gōngzuò yǔ shēnghuó de pínghéng.
examples.english: Most respondents said they did not want to work overtime; in other words, they value work-life balance more.

exercises.sentence: 该项目已经超出预算一倍，___，原计划已经无法执行。
exercises.english: The project is already 100% over budget; in other words, the original plan can no longer be carried out.
exercises.explanation: The second clause spells out what the first means: 换言之.

exercises.sentence: 网购规模迅速增长，___，快递包装造成的污染也越来越严重。
exercises.english: Online shopping is growing rapidly; at the same time, pollution from delivery packaging is getting worse.
exercises.explanation: Two developments happening in parallel: 与此同时.

exercises.sentence: 这家餐厅的菜味道很好。___，服务也非常周到。
exercises.english: The food at this restaurant is very good. What's more, the service is very attentive too.
exercises.explanation: Adding a further positive point in the same direction: 不仅如此.

options: 他的方法简单有效。不仅如此，成本也很低。
物价上涨，与此同时，工资却没有增加。
这台电脑很便宜。不仅如此，它的质量很差。
他连续三年获奖，换言之，他是公认的优秀员工。
exercises.explanation: 不仅如此 adds a point in the same direction; for a contrast use 但是 / 然而.

exercises.english: Cities keep expanding; at the same time, traffic problems are increasingly serious.
exercises.pinyin: Chéngshì búduàn kuòdà, yǔ cǐ tóngshí, jiāotōng wèntí yě rìyì yánzhòng.
exercises.explanation: First development, 与此同时, parallel development with 也.

title: 归根结底: in the final analysis
pattern: Topic, + 归根结底 + 是 / 在于 / 源于 + Root  ·  归根结底，Conclusion
summary: Trace a matter back to its root: 企业竞争，归根结底是人才的竞争.
explanation: **归根结底 (guī gēn jié dǐ)** means 'in the final analysis, at root'. It reduces a complex issue to its **essential cause or nature**, and is typically followed by **是 / 在于 / 源于 / 取决于**: **问题归根结底在于管理**.
It is not a time word. It never means 'finally, in the end' in a sequence of events — that is **最后 / 终于**. It also differs from **总之** ('in short'), which summarises; 归根结底 digs down to the root.
**Register:** argumentative writing, editorials and formal speeches. The colloquial equivalent is **说到底** or **说白了**. A variant written form is **归根到底**.
mistakes: ✗ 我们等了三个小时，归根结底他来了。 → ✓ 我们等了三个小时，他终于来了。 归根结底 is about root causes, not the end of a time sequence.
✗ 归根结底，今天天气很好。 → ✓ 归根结底，这是一个观念问题。 It needs a preceding discussion and an essential conclusion.

examples.hanzi: 企业之间的竞争，归根结底是人才的竞争。
examples.pinyin: Qǐyè zhī jiān de jìngzhēng, guī gēn jié dǐ shì réncái de jìngzhēng.
examples.english: Competition between companies is, in the final analysis, competition for talent.

examples.hanzi: 这些问题归根结底在于管理不善。
examples.pinyin: Zhèxiē wèntí guī gēn jié dǐ zàiyú guǎnlǐ búshàn.
examples.english: These problems ultimately lie in poor management.

examples.hanzi: 归根结底，教育的目的是培养能够独立思考的人。
examples.pinyin: Guī gēn jié dǐ, jiàoyù de mùdì shì péiyǎng nénggòu dúlì sīkǎo de rén.
examples.english: In the final analysis, the purpose of education is to produce people who can think independently.

examples.hanzi: 种种矛盾，归根结底源于沟通不足。
examples.pinyin: Zhǒngzhǒng máodùn, guī gēn jié dǐ yuányú gōutōng bùzú.
examples.english: All these conflicts stem, at root, from a lack of communication.

exercises.sentence: 国与国之间的竞争，___是科技实力的竞争。
exercises.english: Competition between nations is, in the final analysis, a competition of technological strength.
exercises.explanation: Reducing an issue to its essence: 归根结底 + 是. 终于 is a time word.

options: 这些矛盾归根结底是利益分配问题。
我们走了一整天，归根结底到了山顶。
说到底，这还是钱的问题。
城市拥堵归根结底在于规划不合理。
exercises.explanation: 'Finally reached the top' is 终于到了山顶; 归根结底 is not a time adverb.

exercises.english: These problems ultimately lie in poor management.
options: 这些问题总之在于管理不善。
这些问题归根结底在于管理不善。
这些问题终于在于管理不善。
这些问题与此同时在于管理不善。
exercises.explanation: 归根结底 + 在于 points to the root cause.

exercises.prompt: Fill in the blank with the colloquial equivalent of 归根结底.
exercises.sentence: 他们吵来吵去，___还是钱的问题。
exercises.english: They keep arguing, but at the end of the day it's about money.
exercises.explanation: 说到底 = colloquial 归根结底. 到底 alone usually means 'after all / on earth' in questions.

exercises.english: Competition between companies is ultimately competition for talent.
exercises.pinyin: Qǐyè de jìngzhēng guī gēn jié dǐ shì réncái de jìngzhēng.
exercises.explanation: Topic + 归根结底 + 是 + essence.

title: 以…著称: be renowned for
pattern: Subject + 以 + Feature + (而) + 著称 / 闻名 (+ 于 + Scope)
summary: State what a place, person or institution is famous for: 杭州以西湖著称, 以…而闻名于世.
explanation: **以 X 著称 (yǐ X zhùchēng)** means 'to be renowned for X'. The feature goes between 以 and 著称; **闻名** is a near-synonym. **而** may be inserted for rhythm (**以…而闻名**), and the scope can follow with **于**: **著称于世** (world-famous).
著称 is **positive and dignified**: it suits cities, universities, companies, artists and their merits. For notoriety or casual fame use **出名 / 有名**, e.g. **他因脾气大出名**.
**Register:** written, used in travel writing, introductions and reports. In speech say **…因为…很有名 / …最有名的是…**. Keep the order: the feature can never follow 著称 directly (✗ 著称西湖).
mistakes: ✗ 这座城市著称美食。 → ✓ 这座城市以美食著称。 The feature is introduced by 以 before 著称.
✗ 他以懒惰著称。 → ✓ 他是出了名的懒。 著称 is reserved for positive, respectable reputations.

examples.hanzi: 杭州以西湖美景著称于世。
examples.pinyin: Hángzhōu yǐ Xī Hú měijǐng zhùchēng yú shì.
examples.english: Hangzhou is world-famous for the beauty of West Lake.

examples.hanzi: 这所大学以严谨的学风著称。
examples.pinyin: Zhè suǒ dàxué yǐ yánjǐn de xuéfēng zhùchēng.
examples.english: This university is renowned for its rigorous academic culture.

examples.hanzi: 景德镇自古以生产瓷器而闻名。
examples.pinyin: Jǐngdézhèn zìgǔ yǐ shēngchǎn cíqì ér wénmíng.
examples.english: Jingdezhen has been famous since ancient times for producing porcelain.

examples.hanzi: 该地区以温和的气候和丰富的物产著称。
examples.pinyin: Gāi dìqū yǐ wēnhé de qìhòu hé fēngfù de wùchǎn zhùchēng.
examples.english: The region is known for its mild climate and abundant produce.

exercises.sentence: 桂林___山水秀丽著称于世。
exercises.english: Guilin is world-famous for its beautiful landscapes.
exercises.explanation: 以 + feature + 著称: the feature is marked by 以.

exercises.sentence: 这家老字号以精湛的手艺___闻名全国。
exercises.english: This time-honoured shop is famous nationwide for its superb craftsmanship.
exercises.explanation: 以…而闻名: 而 links the means phrase to the verb.
Subject + 以 + feature + 著称.

exercises.english: This university is renowned for its rigorous academic culture.
options: Zhè suǒ dàxué yǐ yánjǐn de xuéfēng zhùchēng.
Zhè suǒ dàxué yǐ yánjǐn de xuéfēng zhùchèng.
Zhè suǒ dàxué yú yánjǐn de xuéfēng zhùchēng.
Zhè suǒ dàxué zhùchēng yǐ yánjǐn de xuéfēng.
exercises.explanation: 著称 is zhùchēng (称 first tone in this word), and 以 precedes the feature.

exercises.english: Hangzhou is world-famous for the beauty of West Lake.
exercises.pinyin: Hángzhōu yǐ Xī Hú měijǐng zhùchēng yú shì.
exercises.explanation: 以 + feature + 著称 + 于 + scope.

title: 堪称: can rightly be called
pattern: Subject + 堪称 + Evaluative Noun (典范 / 经典 / 奇迹 / 一绝)
summary: High praise in writing: 他的书法堪称一绝; 这座桥堪称奇迹.
explanation: **堪称 (kānchēng)** means 'deserves to be called, can rightly be called'. 堪 = 'worthy of', 称 = 'call'. It is followed by an **evaluative noun phrase**: **典范** (model), **经典** (classic), **奇迹** (miracle), **一绝** (unrivalled), **楷模**, **…之最**.

Because 堪称 already contains the meaning 'be called', it does not need **是**, and it is not followed by a degree adverb + adjective (✗ 堪称很好). It is almost always praise; do not confuse it with **不堪** (unbearable: 不堪设想, 不堪一击).
**Register:** written commentary, reviews, journalism. In speech say **可以说是… / 简直是… / 算得上…**.
mistakes: ✗ 他的厨艺堪称非常好。 → ✓ 他的厨艺堪称一绝。 堪称 takes an evaluative noun, not degree + adjective.
✗ 这部电影堪称是经典。 → ✓ 这部电影堪称经典。 称 already means 'be called'; 是 is redundant in careful writing.

examples.hanzi: 这座大桥堪称世界桥梁史上的奇迹。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zuò dàqiáo kānchēng shìjiè qiáoliáng shǐ shang de qíjì.
examples.english: This bridge can rightly be called a miracle in the history of bridge-building.

examples.hanzi: 他的书法堪称一绝。
examples.pinyin: Tā de shūfǎ kānchēng yì jué.
examples.english: His calligraphy is truly unrivalled.

examples.hanzi: 这部电影无论剧情还是表演，都堪称经典。
examples.pinyin: Zhè bù diànyǐng wúlùn jùqíng háishi biǎoyǎn, dōu kānchēng jīngdiǎn.
examples.english: Whether in plot or performance, this film deserves to be called a classic.

exercises.sentence: 这位老人几十年如一日地照顾邻居，___道德楷模。
exercises.english: The old man has cared for his neighbours day in, day out for decades — a true moral role model.
exercises.explanation: 堪称 = deserves to be called. 号称 suggests a self-proclaimed or nominal claim, 声称 = claim, 不堪 = unbearable.

exercises.sentence: 这道菜色香味俱全，堪称___。
exercises.english: This dish excels in colour, aroma and taste — truly unrivalled.
exercises.explanation: 堪称 is followed by an evaluative noun such as 一绝, not an adjective.

options: 他的演讲堪称精彩极了。
这座古建筑堪称建筑史上的杰作。
她的表演堪称完美之作。
exercises.explanation: 堪称 + adjective + 极了 is wrong. Say 他的演讲堪称经典 or 他的演讲精彩极了.

exercises.english: His calligraphy is truly unrivalled.
exercises.explanation: 堪称一绝 is the set collocation.

exercises.english: The company's after-sales service is a model for the industry.
exercises.pinyin: Gāi gōngsī de shòuhòu fúwù kānchēng hángyè diǎnfàn.
exercises.explanation: Subject + 堪称 + evaluative noun.

title: 不亚于 / 莫过于: no less than, nothing beats
pattern: A + 不亚于 + B  ·  最 + Adj + 的 (+ Noun) + 莫过于 + X
summary: Formal comparison: 他的中文不亚于中国人 (no worse than); 最大的幸福莫过于… (nothing is greater than).
explanation: **不亚于 (bú yà yú)** means 'not inferior to, no less than'. 亚 = second-rate, 于 = than. **A 不亚于 B** = A is at least as good / big / serious as B: **他的中文水平不亚于中国人**. It is often used to praise, or to stress the seriousness of something: **损失不亚于一场战争**.
**莫过于 (mò guò yú)** means 'nothing surpasses …', i.e. 'the most … is …'. It usually follows a phrase with **最**: **人生最大的幸福莫过于家人平安**. 莫 here is the classical 'nothing / no one'.
**Register:** both are formal and written, but also heard in educated speech. Colloquial equivalents: **不比…差 / 跟…差不多** and **最…的就是…**. Neither combines with 比 (✗ 比…不亚于).
mistakes: ✗ 他的水平比专业运动员不亚于。 → ✓ 他的水平不亚于专业运动员。 不亚于 already contains the comparison; do not add 比.
✗ 让我开心的事莫过于很多。 → ✓ 最让我开心的事莫过于和家人团聚。 莫过于 introduces the single top item, typically after 最.

examples.hanzi: 他的中文水平不亚于中国人。
examples.pinyin: Tā de Zhōngwén shuǐpíng bú yà yú Zhōngguórén.
examples.english: His Chinese is no worse than a native speaker's.

examples.hanzi: 这次地震造成的损失不亚于一场战争。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì dìzhèn zàochéng de sǔnshī bú yà yú yì chǎng zhànzhēng.
examples.english: The losses caused by this earthquake are no less than those of a war.

examples.hanzi: 人生最大的幸福莫过于家人平安健康。
examples.pinyin: Rénshēng zuì dà de xìngfú mò guò yú jiārén píng'ān jiànkāng.
examples.english: The greatest happiness in life is for one's family to be safe and healthy.

examples.hanzi: 学习语言最有效的方法，莫过于身处语言环境之中。
examples.pinyin: Xuéxí yǔyán zuì yǒuxiào de fāngfǎ, mò guò yú shēn chǔ yǔyán huánjìng zhī zhōng.
examples.english: There is no more effective way to learn a language than immersing yourself in it.

exercises.sentence: 这位业余棋手的实力___职业选手。
exercises.english: This amateur chess player's skill is no less than that of a professional.
exercises.explanation: Comparing A with B as equal or better: 不亚于.

exercises.sentence: 旅行中最令人难忘的，___当地人的热情好客。
exercises.english: The most memorable thing on the trip was the locals' warm hospitality.
exercises.explanation: 最… + 莫过于 + top item.

options: 这场比赛的激烈程度不亚于决赛。
最痛苦的事莫过于失去亲人。
她的厨艺比专业厨师不亚于。
对学生来说，最重要的莫过于养成好习惯。
exercises.explanation: Do not combine 比 with 不亚于. Say 她的厨艺不亚于专业厨师.

exercises.english: His Chinese is no worse than a native speaker's.
options: Tā de Zhōngwén shuǐpíng mò guò yú Zhōngguórén.
Tā de Zhōngwén shuǐpíng bù yà yú Zhōngguórén.
Tā de Zhōngwén shuǐpíng bú yà yú Zhōngguórén.
Tā de Zhōngwén shuǐpíng bú yǎ yú Zhōngguórén.
exercises.explanation: 不 before fourth-tone 亚 (yà) becomes bú.

title: 无非: nothing more than
pattern: Subject + 无非 (+ 是) + X (+ 而已 / 罢了)
summary: Downplay something as 'merely, just': 他说了半天，无非是想要钱.
explanation: **无非 (wúfēi)** means 'nothing but, merely, simply'. It **reduces something to a small, obvious core**, often slightly dismissive: **他说了半天，无非是想让我们多给钱**. It is frequently followed by **是** and closed with **而已 / 罢了**.

It can introduce a short list of ordinary things: **周末无非看看书、散散步**. Because it belittles, it does not go with words that emphasise greatness. Do not confuse it with **莫非** (HSK 6: 'could it be that…?') or with **无所** (nothing to …).
**Register:** neutral to written; common in essays and commentary but also in educated speech. More colloquial: **不过是 / 只不过 / 就是**.
mistakes: ✗ 他的成就无非非常伟大。 → ✓ 他的成就非常伟大。 无非 belittles; it cannot introduce emphatic praise.
✗ 无非他生病了？ → ✓ 莫非他生病了？ For 'could it be that…?' use 莫非.

examples.hanzi: 他说了半天，无非是想让我们多给点儿钱。
examples.pinyin: Tā shuō le bàntiān, wúfēi shì xiǎng ràng wǒmen duō gěi diǎnr qián.
examples.english: He talked for ages, but all he wanted was for us to give him more money.

examples.hanzi: 所谓成功的秘诀，无非是坚持和努力罢了。
examples.pinyin: Suǒwèi chénggōng de mìjué, wúfēi shì jiānchí hé nǔlì bàle.
examples.english: The so-called secret of success is nothing more than perseverance and hard work.

examples.hanzi: 周末他无非看看书、散散步。
examples.pinyin: Zhōumò tā wúfēi kànkan shū, sànsan bù.
examples.english: At the weekend he just reads and goes for walks.

examples.hanzi: 大家争论的焦点，无非是资金如何分配。
examples.pinyin: Dàjiā zhēnglùn de jiāodiǎn, wúfēi shì zījīn rúhé fēnpèi.
examples.english: The crux of the debate is simply how the funds are to be allocated.

exercises.sentence: 他这么做，___是想引起别人的注意罢了。
exercises.english: He does this simply to get attention.
exercises.explanation: 无非是…罢了 = 'nothing more than…'. 莫非 asks 'could it be…?'.

exercises.prompt: Fill in the blank with the more colloquial equivalent of 无非.
exercises.sentence: 他说那么多，___想借钱。
exercises.english: He said so much, but he just wants to borrow money.
exercises.explanation: 不过是 = colloquial 无非是.

options: 所谓秘诀，无非是多练习而已。
他的爱好无非是钓鱼、下棋。
大家担心的无非是安全问题。
exercises.explanation: A 'could it be that…?' question needs 莫非: 莫非他已经知道了？

exercises.english: The secret of success is nothing more than perseverance.
options: 成功的秘诀莫非是坚持罢了。
成功的秘诀无非是坚持罢了。
成功的秘诀无所是坚持罢了。
成功的秘诀堪称是坚持罢了。
exercises.explanation: 无非是…罢了 frames the 'merely' meaning.

exercises.english: He does this simply because he wants to become famous.
exercises.pinyin: Tā zhèyàng zuò wúfēi shì xiǎng chūmíng bàle.
exercises.explanation: Topic + 无非是 + core motive + 罢了.
